content: पूर्ववत् {%a.%} .²1 Having something antecedent or a cause. .²2 Relating to something preceding; पूर्ववन्तोऽविधानार्थाः˚ <ls>MS. 1. 4. 17</ls>. (<ab>cf.</ab> ये हि पूर्ववन्तो विदितपूर्वमर्थमभिवदन्ति ते अविधानार्थाः <ls>ŚB. on MS.</ls> on <ab>ibid.</ab>). --{%n.%} One of the three kinds of अनुमान, inference of the effect from the cause; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} inferring from the rising of clouds that rain will fall. --{%ind.%} As before.
